description: 監管者（warden）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 監管者

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a boss called Warden, huge and imposing, about six heads tall: massive silver-white heavy armor with enormous shoulder pauldrons, a very thick chest plate, huge forearm guards and knee armor, a smooth expressionless faceless helmet with a thin red visor line, black boots, big gloves, red neon lines.
